mapper.insert: INSERT INTO approval_record (transaction_id, level, approver_id, approver_name, action, status_before, status_after, comment, created_at) VALUES (#{transactionId}, #{level}, #{approverId}, #{approverName}, #{action}, #{statusBefore}, #{statusAfter}, #{comment}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, transaction_id AS transactionId, level, approver_id AS approverId, approver_name AS approverName, action, status_before AS statusBefore, status_after AS statusAfter, comment, created_at AS createdAt FROM approval_record WHERE transaction_id = #{transactionId} ORDER BY created_at, id
